source_observations: RearLogistics passes the actual factory only for its automatic input creation; existing destination/type outstanding-promise deduction remains.

RearSimulation validates registered owner/current destination/ingredient, stamps model-local duty provenance before internal request_haul settling; untagged manual/other-owner requests never gain inferred provenance.

Existing settlement finishes due owners/actors/storage constraints, then reconciles explicitly tagged unselected groups before ANY idle-hauler _start_job. _job_option/_start_job contain no new production queries or changed reservation/deposit rules.

FixedProduction enduring input query ignores temporary pause/access/operators/staffing/batch eligibility, preserving existing whole-recipe missing-input and output-minimum coverage rules; disabled or satisfied intent has no missing inputs.

Heavy override requires its existing accepted order, then uses existing production-owned enabled/target/order semantics. No accepted order/batch/bay/fleet/parking mutation; Selectable inherits current recipe/spec without new hook.

Transaction-local captured counts include every actor.load stage (Approach/Pickup/Source blocked/Carry/Drop). Group current missing less other live/manual promises and same-owner captured portions once; distribute allowable unselected quantities across old jobs.

Only automatic requested targets/reasons can shrink. No increase here, no cancel_job, cancel flag, claim release, reroute, receipt credit, consumed/finished/stock mutation, hold or Resume. Later supplier eligibility creates fresh uncovered jobs normally.
cost_and_lifetime: No new timer, frame poll, subscription, generic invalidation or route planning change.
One local actor-load/outstanding-job grouping pass per existing settlement admission transaction/changed immediate boundary; no extra production/stock query for each hauler or job candidate.

Only affected factories with an unselected tagged remainder query current intent once; reuse that ephemeral result across their groups/jobs. Continuous target check needs no output stock scan; Stock target uses existing coverage query once per affected owner. No persistent demand/history cache.
Provenance is scalar current-model duty identity, not a retained owner reference/cycle. Missing current owner retires only unselected work, retaining captured floor.
limits: Source-backed conditional gap, not an observed ordinary-play failure.
Existing untagged legacy/runtime jobs remain untouched; origin cannot safely be reconstructed from destination/type. No migration/reset is performed.
Temporary eligibility alone is not a stop. Output target uses existing projected whole-batch coverage rules; accepted Heavy order remains its production owner commitment.
Godot compilation and actual command/selection/capture/target/stock timing remain unverified.
No full factory/supply/repeat loop, native input/rendering/pacing or FPS acceptance.
